newsitem.title: USA: Fresh Choice names David Pertl as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Fresh Choice names David Pertl as CFO.

text.p: Fresh Choice Inc on Monday it had named David Pertl as chief financial officer of the company.
The company also said it expected its fourth-quarter results to fall short of earlier expectations.
It said it nevertheless expected its 1996 results to be above the previous year.
"We're moving toward profitability," it said. "We will launch a major television advertising program and an aggressive marketing plan this month to increase sales in 1997," it added.
The company said Pertl would replace David Anderson, who was leaving the company.
Pertl was chief financial officer of Summit Family Restaurants Inc in Salt Lake City, Utah, from 1989 to July 1996, it said.
Fresh Choice Inc operates 48 casual restaurants in California, Washington and Texas.
